description: This file defines API routes for user authentication, including registration and login functionalities, using FastAPI. It handles user creation, password hashing, token generation, and user credential verification.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Database model representing a user, including email, name, role, and password hash.

methods.name: UserResponse register_user(payload: UserCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with email, password, and role.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to authenticate a user and generate a JWT token.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^def register_user(payload: UserCreateRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserResponse:$/
